name: q-sight-command-center
description: Industrial Spatial Intelligence Command Center for authorized assets, logistics, emergency response, infrastructure monitoring, environmental risk, and safety operations.

scripts.build:workers: npm run build -w workers/opensky-ingestor && npm run build -w workers/satellite-ingestor && npm run build -w workers/earthquake-ingestor
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:workers
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w workers/opensky-ingestor && npm run typecheck -w workers/satellite-ingestor && npm run typecheck -w workers/earthquake-ingestor
scripts.verify:web: npm run typecheck:web && npm run build:web
scripts.worker:opensky:mock: cross-env LIVE_INGESTION_ENABLED=false AIRCRAFT_LIVE_ENABLED=false SATELLITE_LIVE_ENABLED=false SEISMIC_LIVE_ENABLED=false LIVE_INGESTOR_WRITE_TO_DB=false MOCK_INGESTOR_WRITE_TO_DB=false npm run start:mock -w workers/opensky-ingestor
scripts.worker:satellite:mock: cross-env LIVE_INGESTION_ENABLED=false AIRCRAFT_LIVE_ENABLED=false SATELLITE_LIVE_ENABLED=false SEISMIC_LIVE_ENABLED=false LIVE_INGESTOR_WRITE_TO_DB=false MOCK_INGESTOR_WRITE_TO_DB=false npm run start:mock -w workers/satellite-ingestor
scripts.worker:earthquake:mock: cross-env LIVE_INGESTION_ENABLED=false AIRCRAFT_LIVE_ENABLED=false SATELLITE_LIVE_ENABLED=false SEISMIC_LIVE_ENABLED=false LIVE_INGESTOR_WRITE_TO_DB=false MOCK_INGESTOR_WRITE_TO_DB=false npm run start:mock -w workers/earthquake-ingestor
scripts.ingest:live:once: npm run ingest:seismic:once && npm run ingest:satellite:once && npm run ingest:aircraft:once
scripts.prototype:verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run build:web && npm run verify:static && node scripts/verify_ingestion.js && node scripts/ws_verify.js
scripts.pilot:verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run build:web && npm run verify:static && node scripts/verify_ingestion.js && node scripts/ws_verify.js
scripts.verify:static: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run worker:opensky:mock && npm run worker:satellite:mock && npm run worker:earthquake:mock && npm run verify:web
scripts.verify:full: npm run db:up && npm run build && npm run typecheck && cross-env MOCK_INGESTOR_WRITE_TO_DB=true npm run worker:opensky:mock && cross-env MOCK_INGESTOR_WRITE_TO_DB=true npm run worker:satellite:mock && cross-env MOCK_INGESTOR_WRITE_TO_DB=true npm run worker:earthquake:mock && npm run verify:web
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test -w apps/api
